Mindathon for schools

An engaging addition to your programme

Mindathon can support schools and training centres looking for hands-on cognitive skill activities that get students actively participating.

Student engagement

Active, social gameplay that keeps students involved from start to finish.

Cognitive skill activities

Challenges that practise memory, focus, speed, flexibility and problem solving.

Group activities

Designed for classrooms and groups — everyone plays, everyone participates.

What we offer

Workshops, programmes and training sessions

Mindathon can be run as workshops, school programmes or training sessions — led by our team or adopted as an activity your educators can facilitate.

  • Workshops — interactive sessions introducing Mindathon to students.
  • School programmes — structured cognitive skill activity blocks.
  • Training sessions — guidance for educators and facilitators.
  • Partnership opportunities — let's discuss what fits your institution.
